premises.title: The Last Lighthouse
premises.logline: Two keepers debate whether the last automated lighthouse should be switched off.

premises.title: Archive of Rain
premises.logline: A courier brings the final recorded storm to a city that has forgotten rain.

premises.title: Borrowed Sunrise
premises.logline: A night-shift astronomer admits that tomorrow's sunrise is only a projection.

characters.name: Tess
characters.description: a sleepless young observatory astronomer with short dark hair, navy jacket, silver star pin, standing on the LEFT inside a glass-dome control room

characters.name: Rho
characters.description: a pragmatic bearded station caretaker with red knit cap and olive work jacket, standing on the RIGHT inside the same glass-dome observatory control room

premises.title: Devil's Grandma
premises.logline: The devil's grandmother won't stop feeding cookies to the tormented souls of hell.

characters.name: grandma
characters.description: Pixar-style 3D elderly grandmother with round glasses, neat bun, cream cardigan, carrying a plate of cookies and a glass of milk

characters.name: soul
characters.description: Pixar-style 3D skinny tormented soul, ragged, mildly on fire, bewildered
